Reading Seminars

Hanzhen Bao

Introduction of the program

I hope to pursue research in geometry and topology.

However, my university does not regularly offer graduate-level courses in algebraic topology, differentiable manifolds, Riemannian geometry, or homological algebra. This reading program is an effort to help fill that gap. For each subject, I undertake a one-on-one reading seminar with a faculty mentor, working through assigned readings and giving regular presentations. This website serves as a place to collect and share the notes developed through these seminars. It also brings together notes on topics that spark my interest at conferences, as well as course notes and related materials.
